name: Avian Rage AP OLD
description: Hundreds of panicked whippoorwills swarm through the area.
disable: DC 43 Nature (master) to calm the birds, DC 45 Occultism (master) to alter your aura, or DC 45 Performance (master) to imitate the living
reset: The trap deactivates and resets if 1 minute passes without any undead or creatures with void healing in the garden.
routine: (1 action) The birds swarm wildly through the garden, pecking and slashing at all undead creatures and creatures with void healing in the garden, dealing (3d10+20) Slashing Damage damage and 1d10 Bleed Damage damage (Basic DC 44 Reflex Saving Throw).

generalAbilities.name: Panic!
generalAbilities.description:
Trigger An undead or a creature with void healing enters the garden

Effect The birds screech in panic, dealing (3d12+20) Sonic Damage damage to all creatures in the garden (Basic DC 44 Fortitude Saving Throw). On a failure, the creature becomes Stunned 1 (Stunned 3 on a critical failure). The trap then rolls initiative.
